summary: Breach Swap, Pearl Catch (Legit Mode), Nametags

changes.title: Breach Swap
changes.detail: New combat module that performs same-tick weapon -> Breach mace attribute swaps on attack (manual clicks and Trigger Bot) and returns to your weapon so you shred armor at sword speed, with Min Breach, Only Crits, Only Armored, Ignore Shields, Skip Smash Falls, and Return Delay settings.

changes.title: Pearl Catch (Legit Mode)
changes.detail: Hold Right Click while holding an Ender Pearl to throw the pearl naturally and automatically follow up with a Wind Charge catch, with configurable Legit Delay and visible-only Legit Auto Aim (releasing early cancels cleanly).

changes.title: Nametags
changes.detail: New StreamProof-compatible render module hiding vanilla labels and rendering custom nametag pills with health/absorption, ping, distance, armor & held item icons, durability bars, and compact enchant badges.

changes.title: Base Finder
changes.detail: New zero-lag chunk tile-entity scanner that clusters player storage, Shulkers, Ender Chests, Beacons, Spawners, and workstations into BASE/STASH/SPAWNER groups with natural chest filtering, 3D boxes/tracers, 2D cluster labels, and discovery coordinate notifications.

changes.title: XRay
changes.detail: Added quick preset groups (Ancient Debris, Storage, Spawners & Vaults, Utility) plus palette-accelerated color-coded 3D Highlight Blocks and Tracers (also works in StreamProof mode).
